comment: The rules a node agent evaluates itself (sparkbox_agent.py EVALUATES must equal this list; agent_test.py checks). SparkBox leaves one of these alerts to the agent only while that node's agent is healthy and acknowledges the current settings hash (agent::agent_sends); endpoint rules also need the head node's agent to list the endpoint in endpointsProbed. Generic threshold and rate rules on the entity kinds in genericEntities are evaluated too. peerRule: raised by the leader agent for a peer nothing answers on; SparkBox leaves node-offline to the agents only when a healthy, current agent lists that node in peersMissing.
